nodes.label: 2D Top-Down Style
nodes.rationale: Very clear view of everyone's position and priority; faster and cheaper to build, small app; but not like real driving (no mirrors, blind spots, sign reading) and hard to judge gaps and speed.

nodes.label: 3D Low-Poly Chase Camera Style (chosen plan)
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it feels like real driving (signs, mirrors, judging the gap), skills transfer to the real road, strong 'wow' in store videos; costs more work (3D roads, camera, performance tuning) and bigger app; whole-junction visibility fixed by a top-down replay view.
